title: Raw adic Weil and frontier transport
statement: Fix D, l, Omega, a normalized lisse family a, completed-system family c, classical realization b, and ClassicalCommon on every base [def-zl-raw-heart-adic-lisse-data]. Suppose a finite-stage partition s:Strata for a heart object M on X has already been supplied. For every identification of X with the reduced geometric fibre of a separated finite-type Y_0, there is Frontier for this same s, with its exact start, finish, ambient maps, smooth affine geometrically connected pieces and normalized geometric projection. For every identification of X with the unreduced geometric fibre and Weil complex K whose restricted carrier is M, every descended immersion through a member of s satisfying the two structure-map and model-projection identities admits WeilLift for the actual mth restricted iterate, at a finite coefficient stage containing s.stage. The lift is rational; no invariant integral lattice is imposed. The fully quantified Lean statement fixes the arbitrary base W, eW, model map j_0 and geometric factor j; it includes the empty and rank-zero cases.

proof.text: Transport the supplied partition across e and apply smooth affine frontier stratification. Use the canonical associativity isomorphism of the two geometric base changes: its first projection is the composite of the two first projections. In the descent proof the finite diagram is descended over this projection, so the piece factorizations hold for this same canonical isomorphism. Transport back along e to obtain the refinement field. The other fields are precisely the finite closed chain, its differences and its smooth affine geometrically connected components. For the Weil clause, the model and field projection equations define geometric Frobenius on W by the pullback universal property, transported through eW. The hypotheses on the model square imply equivariance with the mth ambient Frobenius. Pull the carrier identification and the iterated Weil isomorphism to W, inserting the actual completed-pullback compositors. The model remains lisse under pullback. Fullness of the common classical realization lifts this isomorphism and its inverse; faithfulness proves both inverse equations. The common-stage Hom definition places the two maps and both equations at a single finite enlargement containing s.stage. Take the resulting finite model, its carrier isomorphism, and its rational Weil isomorphism. The realization equation is exactly the conjugation by that carrier and the specified classicalPullIso. The point normalization intertwines all iterates. An invariant integral lattice is never required. Empty partitions make the Weil clause vacuous, and the frontier theorem includes empty geometric schemes.
